advice: Focus on mastering SQL and Python. Build personal projects on cloud platforms. Learn at least one orchestration tool like Airflow or dbt.

next_role: Senior Data Engineer or AI Data Engineer
advice: Get hands-on with Databricks and a cloud data warehouse. Start contributing to architectural decisions. Learn infrastructure as code with Terraform.

next_role: Staff Engineer or AI Data Engineer
advice: Begin building AI/ML integration skills. Take ownership of large-scale systems. Mentor junior engineers and lead design discussions.

next_role: Staff AI Engineer or AI Architect
advice: Deep-dive into LLM orchestration frameworks like LangChain and MCP. Build production RAG systems. Get certified in Databricks and cloud AI platforms.

next_role: Staff GenAI Engineer or Head of AI
advice: Focus on building production-grade LLM applications, not just demos. Learn evaluation frameworks, observability for AI, and responsible AI practices.

next_role: Principal Engineer or VP of Engineering
advice: Influence technical direction across multiple teams. Build deep expertise in one AI domain while maintaining broad systems knowledge. Publish and speak at conferences.
At this level, impact comes through people and decisions, not code. Build strong relationships with business leaders. Think in terms of organizational capability, not individual systems.
